product.eventDescription: Charged when a product row is pushed. A product row is pushed only when this charge fits under maxSpendUsd. Store profile rows use the store event. blocked, unavailable, not_found, robots, spend_capped, and error rows are saved and not billed.

store.eventDescription: Charged when a store profile row is pushed after /products.json returned JSON. A store row is pushed only when this charge fits under maxSpendUsd. A blocked store is not billed.
